failure_modes.what: Cancelling or deleting an order whose RT is CLOSED deletes the leg (013:91-100); if it was the last leg rt_recompute sets the closed RT to cancelled (013:65-71); dl_sync_from_rt then flags (amounts) or soft-deletes (no amounts) the payroll line (011:190-196). 023 tried to keep closed legs but fires first and is overridden. The front meanwhile only warns «είναι κλεισμένο» (rt-feed.js@origin/main:341-345).
failure_modes.gap: B-09 sees it only while the auto line with amounts stays alive; a line without amounts is soft-deleted and nobody sees the closed→cancelled transition (no check reads audit reason «no live legs» with before.status=closed)

failure_modes.what: Un-assigning ONE order of a round trip propagates NULL vehicle to the RT and to every sibling order (013:104-131). The sibling (e.g. matched import) loses its truck in DB while the board shows only the cleared row changing.
failure_modes.gap: B-43 flags the vehicle-less active RT but not that the sibling assignment was erased by someone else's click; audit actor is trigger:rt_sync

failure_modes.what: Order save is 6+ independent requests: orders → stopsSave (3 phases) → rtOnOrderSaved → _syncVeroiaSwitch → syncOrderDownstream (PA, GL/CL/NL, ramp bg, pallets only on PE change) → pending match. Only the DB-trigger parts (RT create 033, dates 028, 046) are atomic with the order row.
failure_modes.gap: no check for: PE order without pallet movement; ramp missing outside the 3-day VS window; PA missing for partner-assigned order

failure_modes.what: After 046 a Delivered click closes the RT and touches dl_entries in the same transaction as orders.status, but plOnDelivered (daily_ops.js:936, no await) and paSyncStatus are separate requests. Result on failure: RT closed + payroll ready, pallets movement missing → invoicing gate later blocked for a reason nobody links to the delivery click.
failure_modes.gap: B-16/B-17 see only movements that exist; a missing movement is invisible (FM-c-04 population gap)

failure_modes.what: ramp.truck_id/driver_id are copied from the order only when the ramp row is created (daily_ramp.js:302). Any later vehicle change — front, rt_sync_to_orders from a TRIP PnL edit, rt_sync_from_order sibling propagation — leaves the ramp board showing the old truck.
failure_modes.gap: B-30 checks links, not vehicle agreement

failure_modes.what: Offline replay (and AI update_record, undo-restore) write orders through the facade without syncOrderDownstream: DB triggers fire (RT, VS status follow, 046 close) but VS creation, GL/CL, PA, pallets and ramp never run. Spans parts a/b/c/d from a part-e mechanism.
failure_modes.gap: B-26 catches the missing VS load after 15′; nothing catches missing PA/pallet/ramp

failure_modes.what: Attach of an open order to a closed RT via 033 yields two «reopened:» audit rows (046 inside the leg INSERT, then 033 with stale target.status). 046 dropped 045 precisely to avoid a second row for one event.
failure_modes.gap: B-36 counts rows, so it double-counts reopen events

failure_modes.what: Mixed RT (≥1 order leg + ≥1 national leg) auto-closes as soon as the order legs are Delivered — the national leg is not counted (046:160-169). The 046 header (l.78-81) says such an RT «δεν κλείνει αυτόματα»; only a pure-national RT is untouched. rt_status_guard also ignores national legs.
failure_modes.gap: latent (0 RTs with national legs on 22/9); becomes live if 034 rt_create_national is ever approved

failure_modes.what: The 046 guard and triggers are verified only once, by the DO block at install (046:344-367). A later DROP/disable (or SQL with session_replication_role=replica) silently returns the system to front-side closing that no longer exists: RTs would then never close.
failure_modes.gap: B-03 would notice only after 3 days; no catalog assertion check exists
